summary: The feasibility gate returned not_2d_applicable (simulation_allowed=false, comparison_valid=false), so Studio did not run: simulation status is 'skipped'. The selected scenario is HotGauge Fig. 9, a transient perf-power-thermal co-simulation of a 7nm Skylake-like 7-core CPU running single-threaded gobmk after idle warmup. It reports a peak MLTD (1 mm radius) of almost 70 C at 7nm versus under 60 C at 14nm. The extraction proposed a custom_2d_steady experiment with an empty floorplan and no power_w, which failed input validation. It has no transient trace and is not a replication. No Studio-derived temperature or MLTD exists, so no numerical comparison with the ~70 C paper value is made. The paper values (about 70 C and under 60 C at 7nm and 14nm, 80 C and 25 C thresholds) are text-derived and approximate, and are context only. Qualitatively, the paper shows that hotspot severity grows from 14nm to 7nm as power density rises with area scaling, and that the hottest core varies with position. These are the paper's own findings and were not checked against any Studio output. The final verdict is that no result can be assessed or confirmed. The extraction lacks per-block geometry and power, and the evidence items lack valid page or asset locators.
limitations: Studio was not run (skipped by the gate), so there is no simulated output and no replication or numerical comparison of any kind.

Gate failures: custom experiment lacks 1-128 blocks and a power_w object; evidence items 0-35 lack valid page or pinned asset locators; no cited thermal observable or steady/transient regime was accepted; adversarial methods/code/parameters/config/data checks are unresolved; and independent page/asset review is pending.

Regime mismatch: the paper observable is transient MLTD over time (about 0.2 ms steps at 5 GHz, after non-uniform idle warmup), while any custom 2D steady run has no transient trace and cannot capture time constants or initial-condition dependence.

Observable mismatch: the paper's MLTD is a die-wide maximum over a 100 um thermal grid with a 1 mm radius, reported over roughly the first 20 ms. Its exact aggregation is only described qualitatively, and a steady 2D peak or gradient would not match the location or aggregation.

Boundary and stack mismatch: 3D-ICE with an active/bulk silicon split, solder TIM, copper spreader, thermal grease and an HS483-ND heatsink with fan at 6000 rpm, versus Studio's unspecified default package and material assumptions. The effective heat transfer coefficient and the ambient used for the Fig. 9 runs are not stated.
Power mismatch: Sniper plus modified McPAT power with temperature-dependent leakage and 11-20% reported errors is not reproducible in Studio, and no per-block or total gobmk power split is published.
Missing inputs: no numeric floorplan (Fig. 5 is an image; Table I gives only areas, and the 5 mm2 die/core statement is ambiguous), no power rows, no digitized Fig. 9 data, and no idle-warmup trace.
The GitHub and Zenodo links are unpinned, absent from the packet, and unverified, so they do not demonstrate that the required inputs exist.

The approximately 70 C and under 60 C values come from text (one being an upper bound) and not from digitized data. They are temperature differences, not absolute temperatures, and per-core values are only qualitative.
